name: Zunil
summary: 24 MWe installed capacity — Ormat binary plant, online since 1999
detail: A 275–300°C liquid-dominated reservoir hosted in andesitic-dacitic volcanics and an underlying granodiorite basement, with fracture-controlled permeability and a vapour-mobile two-phase "steam zone" that has expanded in the upper ~600m as production drew pressure down 15–25 bar over the field's life. Feed zones sit between roughly 550–1370m vertical depth. INDE began exploring the field in the 1970s and drilled thirteen wells through the 1980s and 90s before the 24 MWe Ormat plant came online in 1999; Ormat has operated the wellfield and plant directly since a 2014 agreement revision. Zunil II, a separate reservoir, lies east of Zunil I across the Río Samala.
